svd_axis_rule: PRIMARY: first SVD axis of the per-layer CENTROID matrix, identical to the rho metric internals (corneal_fm.evaluation.marker_gradient_correlation, unchanged), oriented LSC -> differentiated. DIAGNOSTIC: first SVD axis of the centered FULL embedding matrix (PC1) + cosine with the rho axis to rule out a PC artifact.
program_score: mean of z-scored log1p expression across program genes
monotonicity_stats: PC1 layer ordering + cos(rho_axis, PC1) artifact diagnostic
judgement_rule: SVD axis = differentiation axis iff LSC prog rho<0 AND diff prog rho>0 AND 4-layer centroid ordering Spearman==1.0
contrast: frozen (monotonic expected) vs naive (collapse) vs CORN (restore)
